prompt.alinti: Someone just built a Cloud Code agent whose only job is to get you customers. It's called Harvey and it's open source and free. Tell it what you sell and who your ideal customer is and Harvey's going to find leads, research them, and determine if they're the right fit. Then Cloud turns that research into personalized cold emails. It also tracks replies, manages your pipeline, books you meetings on autopilot, and it's all done 24-7 from your computer. It even uses your existing Cloud Code subscription so you're not going to be wasting on API credits. Plus it comes with a live dashboard so you could literally manage your pipeline in real time. Follow me and comment the word Harvey and I'll send you the GitHub repo and the full setup guide.
